summary: Phase 2G verification: /api/html-template/featured rotation fix confirmed. Default call returns pool_size=57 with deterministic per-day pick; ?window_days=14 preserves legacy narrow-window behavior collapsing to pool_size=1 (aged pool); ?window_days=0 equivalent to default; response payload has all required keys; image_url resolves 200; endpoint is public.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: uses Python built-in hash() for daily rotation — PYTHONHASHSEED randomizes across process restarts, so 'same asset all day' only holds within a single worker process. In multi-worker deployments different workers may serve different picks on the same day. Consider hashlib for cross-process determinism if strict daily consistency is required.
Minor style: `__import__("datetime").timedelta(...)` at line 310 — `timedelta` is likely already importable at module scope; direct import is cleaner.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 57 html_bulk assets. No writes to DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2G fix (widening default window_days to 0) is verified working end-to-end via public URL. 7 regression tests added at /app/backend/tests/test_featured_rotation_verification.py covering default rotation, deterministic pick, legacy window_days=14, window_days=0 equivalence, payload schema, image_url resolution, and public access.
